extracted.intended_audience: readers of Popular Science Monthly (scientists, naturalists, and the educated public interested in current science and literature)
extracted.subtask_description: Short book notices, journal reviews, and miscellany items summarizing and evaluating recent scientific and literary publications for a general but learned audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Magazine/journal stated scope and aims
rubrics_metrics.description: The object of this magazine is to give the results of the latest researches in all the Oriental lands and in the countries of classical history; it is intended also to embrace many subjects of a more general character, such as the manners and customs of all nations, their traditions, mythologies, religious notions, language, and literature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the journal to publish original research across relevant subfields, and include broader cultural and comparative material. (From the Oriental and Biblical Journal notice.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Article suitability for specialist and practitioner audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Present original articles of value both to the specialist and the agriculturist on the subject of North American insects and notices of current entomological literature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material should combine careful research, new facts, and useful illustrations to appeal to both researchers and applied practitioners. (From North American Entomologist review: 'The articles ... show the results of careful research, present new facts, and are many of them well illustrated.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical utility for practitioners
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep microscopists informed of what is going on that is of particular interest to them; include practical information such as lists of societies, manufacturers, dealers, and apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize up-to-date, practical listings and actionable news for working practitioners rather than purely theoretical content. (From The Microscopist's Annual description.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity of purpose and accessibility for general readers
rubrics_metrics.description: Primers are prepared for the purpose of diffusing as widely and cheaply as possible a knowledge of the elementary facts of preventive medicine ... and of teaching people how to take care of themselves, their children, etc. They are written from an American point of view, with especial reference to our climate, sanitary legislation, and modes of life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educational health material should be practical, locally relevant, affordable, and accessible in tone and length. (From American Health Primers notice.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensiveness and documentary breadth in historical/travel works
rubrics_metrics.description: The title gives as clear an idea of the character of this book as can be gained from a fuller description. The historical sketch is ample and satisfactory. Travelers' descriptions date from Charlevoix (1721) and are quoted from a host of authors of various nationalities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A strong regional/history volume should combine ample historical sketching with a wide variety of primary traveler accounts and diverse national perspectives. (From Thousand Islands notice.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical thoroughness and reporting in government/technical surveys
rubrics_metrics.description: The report shows progress in the triangulation of Lake Erie, the triangulation connecting Lake Erie with Lake Michigan, the erection of stations ... longitudes and latitudes ... several coast-charts ... charts of the Mississippi south of Memphis have been completed. Important facts such as observation of sand-waves with dimensions and velocities are noted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Survey reports should document methods, progress in triangulation and charting, exact geodetic determinations, and noteworthy empirical observations with measured dimensions and rates. (From Annual Report on Surveys notice.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Expectation for scientific exposition of inventions/pamphlets
rubrics_metrics.description: Points of superiority are set forth, and the process of manufacture is described in the pamphlet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short technical pamphlets introducing a new material or process should clearly state claimed advantages and provide a description of manufacturing/process details. (From Heveenoid pamphlet notice.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation and pedagogical accessibility for technical lectures
rubrics_metrics.description: This work comprises the substance of a lecture ... translated into English to make it more accessible to Japanese students; useful minerals are ranked; processes of mining and reducing ores are described; summary of mining law and government measures are reviewed; plates give representations of tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When adapting technical lectures for wider use, include translations, practical rankings, method descriptions, legal/regulatory context, and illustrative plates to aid comprehension and application. (From Memoirs of the Science Department, University of Tokio notice.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal editorial functions and content mix
rubrics_metrics.description: This journal is open to original contributions in all departments of philology, gives condensed reports of current philological work, summaries of the chief articles in the principal philological journals of Europe, and keeps watch over the fragmentary and occasional literature to which the isolated American scholar seldom has full access.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A disciplinary journal should publish original scholarship while also providing condensed reports, international coverage, and bibliographic surveillance of fragmentary literature to serve its scholarly community. (From American Journal of Philology notice.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical and topical comprehensiveness in state reports
rubrics_metrics.description: This report embraces ninety-nine tables of agricultural, mercantile, manufacturing, financial, and other statistics, by counties and townships. It also embodies the report of the State Health Commission with papers on health in the schoolroom, topography and climate, sewage and drainage, popular customs and heredity, and geology's influence on local diseases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State-level reports should combine comprehensive statistical tables with topical expert papers addressing public health, environment, and social factors to inform governance. (From First Annual Report of the Department of Statistics and Geology notice.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliographic completeness for 'publications received' notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Each received publication is listed with title, author, publisher, year, pages, and price when given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short notices should include full bibliographic details (title, author, imprint, pagination, price) and a concise characterization of scope or content to inform readers. (From Publications Received section.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Critical assessment of historical/archaeological claims
rubrics_metrics.description: A work combining evidences, manuscripts, drawings, etc., assuming to show that an institution similar to freemasonry existed in Egypt before pyramids and obelisks can be 'curious and interesting if not historical and scientific.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating antiquity claims, distinguish between interesting aggregate materials and rigorous historical/scientific proof; flag works that are more curious compilation than critically substantiated scholarship. (From The Obelisk and Freemasonry notice.)
